# @sharadox/web-library

> General TypeScript utilities shared by every Sharadox library (no dependencies). Topic code moved to *-web-library topic packages (internationalization, metadata, style, consent, animation, scroll, pointer, form, time, test).

- type-guard/is-string → isString(value): value is string
- type-guard/is-non-empty-string → isNonEmptyString(value)
- type-guard/is-number → isNumber(value): finite numbers
- type-guard/is-boolean → isBoolean(value)
- type-guard/is-record → isRecord(value): plain objects
- type-guard/is-defined → isDefined(value): not null/undefined
- class-name → classNames(...names): joins truthy names
- html/escape → escapeHtml(text)
- text/separate → separate(separator, ...parts): "a • b", skipping empty parts
- math/clamp, math/radians, math/pseudo-random
- assert/never → assertNever(value): throws; for exhaustive switches
- Import by path: `import { isString } from "@sharadox/web-library/type-guard/is-string";`
- Licence: Sharadox Open Source Licence 0.1.0
